title: Generic JSON Deserialization Directly Into Domain Types
damaged_code:
```rust
#[derive(Deserialize)]
pub struct InventoryItem {
    pub name: String,
    pub quantity: i32, // Bypasses business rule: quantity cannot be negative
}
```
pattern: Deriving deserialization rules directly on core domain models containing public mutable fields.
why_bad: It allows external network clients to bypass your domain logic and validated constructors. This can inject corrupted or logically invalid states directly into memory.
detection: Structs inside domain directories implementing `serde::Deserialize` without a validated intermediate DTO wrapper.
counterexample: Internal serialization of domain states for trusted database engines.
source: *Domain Modeling made Functional* by Scott Wlaschin (Chapter 11, p. 245, "Deserialization Gates").
